**Summary**  
Patient C3N-00834 has a GNN-A out-of-fold risk estimate of 39.3% for stage III–IV ccRCC [pred:C3N-00834:gnn]. The model attributes 65.7% of the top-10 driver weight to tumor proteins and 34.3% to recorded cardiovascular comorbidities [contrib:C3N-00834:NCBIGene:1615][contrib:C3N-00834:HP:0001658]. The tumor carries a somatic VHL truncation (p.RPRPVLRSV58del) [pt:C3N-00834:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:7428], and the most dysregulated proteins include strongly up-regulated DARS1, ERO1A, GFPT1, HSD17B7, CFAP36 and down-regulated MYH14, CORO2B, ABLIM1 [pt:C3N-00834:protein_up:NCBIGene:1615][pt:C3N-00834:protein_down:NCBIGene:79784].

**Evidence paths**  
- VHL loss → HIF stabilization (canonical ccRCC mechanism) is implied by the somatic VHL mutation [pt:C3N-00834:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:7428].  
- DARS1 (top tumor driver, z=21.9) binds VBP1, which directly interacts with VHL [E320080][E122099].
